\noindent\textbf{Parameter definitions.}
\begin{description}
\setlength{\itemsep}{0.25em}
\item[$\lbrack GCaMP\rbrack$] Total intracellular indicator concentration used in the model.
\item[$R_f$] Apparent fluorescence dynamic range (scaling factor mapping indicator state to measured $\Delta F/F$).
\item[$\Delta Ca_{spike}$] Per-spike calcium increment delivered to the modeled compartment.
\item[$ca_0$] Basal intracellular calcium concentration.
\item[$\gamma$] Effective first-order calcium clearance rate constant.
\item[$Buffer_{Endo}$] Total endogenous calcium buffer concentration.
\item[$k_{on, Endo}$] Calcium binding on-rate to the endogenous buffer.
\item[$k_{off, Endo}$] Calcium unbinding off-rate from the endogenous buffer.
\item[$\lbrack ATP\rbrack$] Total ATP concentration.
\item[$k_{on, ATP}$] Calcium binding on-rate to the ATP buffer.
\item[$k_{off, ATP}$] Calcium unbinding off-rate from the ATP buffer.
\item[$\lbrack Parv\rbrack$] Total parvalbumin concentration.
\item[$k_{on, Parv, Ca^{2+}}$] Calcium binding on-rate to the parvalbumin buffer.
\item[$k_{off, Parv, Ca^{2+}}$] Calcium unbinding off-rate from the parvalbumin buffer.
\item[$k_{on, Parv, Mg^{2+}}$] Magnesium binding on-rate to the parvalbumin buffer.
\item[$k_{off, Parv, Mg^{2+}}$] Magnesium unbinding off-rate from the parvalbumin buffer.
\item[$mg_0$] Basal intracellular magnesium concentration.
\end{description}
